focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚光伏产品加征反倾销税，中企出口策略面临调整
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，对来自马来西亚、泰国、越南和柬埔寨的光伏电池及组件加征反倾销税，税率最高达271.28%。该调查起源于美国本土制造商对中国企业通过东南亚转口规避关税的指控。中国光伏企业需评估供应链布局，考虑在美建厂或转向其他市场以降低风险。
focus.title_en: US Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Solar Products from Southeast Asia, Forcing Chinese Exporters to Adjust Strategies
focus.summary_en: The US Department of Commerce preliminarily ruled to impose anti-dumping duties on solar cells and modules from Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and Cambodia, with rates up to 271.28%. The investigation stems from allegations by US manufacturers that Chinese firms circumvent tariffs via Southeast Asia. Chinese solar enterprises should reassess supply chains, consider building factories in the US, or explore alternative markets.

case.title: 英国法院认定中国仲裁裁决违反公共政策，中企跨境执行需强化程序合规
case.summary: 英国高等法院以仲裁庭未给予当事人充分陈述机会为由，拒绝执行一份中国国际经济贸易仲裁委员会（CIETAC）作出的裁决。法院认为该仲裁程序存在严重不公，违反英国公共政策。此案警示中企在涉外仲裁中应确保程序正义，包括通知送达、证据交换及听证安排，以保障裁决在国际间的可执行性。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院 · 2026年6月
case.title_en: UK Court Refuses Enforcement of Chinese Arbitral Award on Public Policy Grounds, Highlighting Need for Procedural Compliance
case.summary_en: The High Court of England and Wales refused to enforce a CIETAC award, finding that the tribunal failed to provide the party with adequate opportunity to present its case, constituting a serious procedural irregularity contrary to UK public policy. This case underscores the importance of ensuring procedural fairness—including proper service, evidence exchange, and hearing arrangements—in international arbitration to facilitate cross-border enforcement.
case.source_en: Source: High Court of England and Wales · June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规出台，简化企业数据出境安全评估流程
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规定（试行）》，对区内企业向香港、澳门传输非敏感个人信息和重要数据实施负面清单管理，清单外数据可免于安全评估。该政策旨在促进大湾区数字贸易与金融科技发展，企业需及时梳理数据资产，判断是否落入负面清单范畴。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年7月
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area Simplify Security Assessment for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the 'Provisions on the Management of Cross-Border Data Flow Security in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', introducing a negative list approach for transferring non-sensitive personal information and important data to Hong Kong and Macao. Data not on the list is exempt from security assessment. This policy aims to boost digital trade and fintech in the region; enterprises should promptly map their data assets to determine if they fall under the negative list.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · July 2026

analysis.title: 美国对华投资限制令扩展至半导体和AI领域，中企需建立合规审查机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部宣布扩大对华投资限制范围，新增半导体制造、先进人工智能和量子计算领域，禁止或限制美国主体对中国相关实体进行股权投资。中国出海企业应建立双向投资合规审查机制，在引入美元基金或与美国企业合作前，评估交易是否触发限制，并考虑替代融资渠道。
analysis.title_en: US Expands Investment Restrictions to Semiconductors and AI, Chinese Companies Urged to Establish Compliance Screening
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury expanded investment restrictions on China, adding semiconductor manufacturing, advanced AI, and quantum computing, prohibiting or limiting US persons from equity investments in Chinese entities in these sectors. Chinese companies going global should set up a two-way compliance screening mechanism to assess whether transactions with US funds or partners trigger restrictions, and consider alternative financing channels.
